high: Quiz max_attempts enforcement and retake cooldown not verified in submit endpoint.
Recertification cycle NOM-specific expiry windows (e.g. annual for NOM-030) not obviously modeled.
No DC-3 folio auto-generation vs manual entry rules documented.
No bulk user import (CSV/XLSX) endpoint - Client Admin onboarding hundreds of employees has no path.
No role-based analytics scoping for Client (per-company drilldown) documented.
No SCORM/xAPI ingestion for third-party course content.
No public course catalog filter by NOM reference or category.
medium: DTO schemas empty in Swagger JSON (all DTOs show properties: {}) - @ApiProperty decorators missing so client can't auto-generate types.
No pagination params documented on list endpoints (users, companies, enrollments, certificates, audit).
No rate limiting visible (no throttler module in AppModule).
No refresh flow for uploaded file signed URLs.
Support tickets lack threaded replies and attachments.
Notifications have no push/websocket delivery channel.
No versioning on course content or quizzes.
Audit log has no export endpoint (only paginated GET).
